about.heading: About
about.neuropsychologyText: Her interest in neuropsychology was present from the start of her studies. Today, Mariana supervises the Instituto Nexium team in neuropsychological assessment and rehabilitation across all ages — from preschool age to older adults — with a growing focus on aging and geriatric neuropsychology.
about.clinicalText: Clinical care takes place across Instituto Nexium's units — in Aldeia da Serra, Alphaville, Itu, Jundiaí and Sorocaba —, providing neuropsychological assessment and rehabilitation across the lifespan. Mariana is the Institute's head and clinical supervisor, with no personal patient schedule of her own.
